The cushion you are seated on will float. In water landing remove

SEAT BELTS
When the seat belt sign is off you may move around in the
cabin as much as you like. However, we suggest you keep your
seat belt loosely fastened at all times while in your seats.

PORTABLE ELECTRONIC DEVICES
Are you carrying a portable radio or recorder? Federal Aviation
Agency (FAA) regulation prohibits the operation in-flight of certain
portable electronic devices since they can interfere with the air-
craft's navigation system. Please check with the stewardess before
operating your radio, dictating machine or recorder.
